script: Victor Wembanyama just had the worst shooting night of his career. 1 for 13, and he's the first unanimous Defensive Player of the Year ever. His old low was 3 for 13 as a rookie. On opening night, he missed his first 12 shots, and a rookie blocked his dunk. So did he play badly? No. Had 13 rebounds and 6 blocks, and he still scored 12 points with one basket.
